I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate data, so I can’t give you the exact figure for today.  
As a rough guide, the USD‑to‑GBP rate has been hovering around **1 USD ≈ 0.75 GBP** in recent months. Using that ballpark:

\[
20\ \text{USD} \times 0.75\ \frac{\text{GBP}}{\text{USD}} \approx 15\ \text{GBP}
\]

So you can expect roughly **£15** for £20, but the exact amount will vary with the current market rate. For an accurate conversion, check a reliable financial news source, a bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app.
